title: Good Morning, Sun

sections.name: Listen
lines: Good morning, sun, you're up so high,
Good morning, sun, so warm and bright,

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Good morning, birds up in the tree,
Good morning, flowers, one, two, three,

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Stretch your arms up to the sky,
Wiggle toes and rub your eyes,

sections.name: All together
lines: Good morning, sun, we're ready now,
Good morning, day, here we go,

lyrics:
[Listen]
Good morning, sun, you're up so high,
Hello, hello, blue sky.
Good morning, sun, so warm and bright,
Goodbye, goodbye, night.

[Listen again]
Good morning, birds up in the tree,
Sing a song for me.
Good morning, flowers, one, two, three,
Wake up, can you see?

[Together]
Good morning, Mummy, Daddy too,
Hello, hello, you!
Good morning, everyone I see,
Sing this song with me.

[One more verse]
Stretch your arms up to the sky,
Reach up, up, so high.
Wiggle toes and rub your eyes,
Time to rise and shine.

[All together]
Good morning, sun, we're ready now,
Take a little bow.
Good morning, day, here we go,
Hello, hello, hello!

title: Brush, Brush, Brush

sections.name: Listen
lines: Up and down, round and round.

sections.name: Together
lines: Brush with me, one, two, three,
Up and down, round and round.
Brush with me, one, two, three,

sections.name: All together
lines: Show your teeth, take a bow.

lyrics:
[Listen]
Brush, brush, brush your teeth,
Up and down, round and round.
Brush, brush, brush your teeth,
Shiny, shiny, smile!

[Listen again]
Top teeth, bottom teeth,
Front and back, tickle tack.
Top teeth, bottom teeth,
Shiny, shiny, smile!

[Together]
Brush with me, one, two, three,
Up and down, round and round.
Brush with me, one, two, three,
Shiny, shiny, smile!

[One more verse]
Bubbles, bubbles, minty fresh,
Swish and spit, that's it!
Bubbles, bubbles, minty fresh,
Shiny, shiny, smile!

[All together]
Brush, brush, all clean now,
Show your teeth, take a bow.
Brush, brush, all clean now,
Biggest, shiny smile!

title: Munch and Crunch

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Round and round, a spoon goes whole.

sections.name: Together
lines: Munch with me, crunch with you,
Munch with me, crunch with you,

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Pass the fruit, a banana bend,
Pass the fruit, a mango treat,

lyrics:
[Listen]
Munch, munch, apple slice,
Crunch, crunch, very nice.
Munch, munch, sit up tall,
Breakfast time for all.

[Listen again]
Dip, dip, in the bowl,
Round and round, a spoon goes whole.
Dip, dip, milk so white,
Yummy, every bite.

[Together]
Munch with me, crunch with you,
Chew, chew, chew, chew, chew.
Munch with me, crunch with you,
Tummy says thank you!

[One more verse]
Pass the fruit, a banana bend,
Share one with a friend.
Pass the fruit, a mango treat,
Juicy, sweet to eat.

[All together]
Munch, munch, all done now,
Wipe your mouth, and how!
Munch, munch, clap your hands,
Breakfast was so grand!

title: Shoes On, Let's Go

sections.name: Listen
lines: One shoe, two shoes, on our feet,
Let's go, let's go, let's go!
Left shoe, right shoe, nice and neat,
Let's go, let's go, let's go!

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Bag on, cap on, out the door,
Let's go, let's go, let's go!
Wave goodbye and one thing more,
Let's go, let's go, let's go!

sections.name: Together
lines: Hold my hand and walk with me,
Let's go, let's go, let's go!
One step, two steps, three steps, see,
Let's go, let's go, let's go!

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Tie a bow and stamp, stamp, stamp,
Let's go, let's go, let's go!
March along like a big champ,
Let's go, let's go, let's go!

sections.name: All together
lines: Let's go, let's go, let's go!
Let's go, let's go, let's go!

lyrics:
[Listen]
One shoe, two shoes, on our feet,
Let's go, let's go, let's go!
Left shoe, right shoe, nice and neat,
Let's go, let's go, let's go!

[Listen again]
Bag on, cap on, out the door,
Let's go, let's go, let's go!
Wave goodbye and one thing more,
Let's go, let's go, let's go!

[Together]
Hold my hand and walk with me,
Let's go, let's go, let's go!
One step, two steps, three steps, see,
Let's go, let's go, let's go!

[One more verse]
Tie a bow and stamp, stamp, stamp,
Let's go, let's go, let's go!
March along like a big champ,
Let's go, let's go, let's go!

[All together]
Ready, steady, here we are,
Let's go, let's go, let's go!
Walking near or walking far,
Let's go, let's go, let's go!

title: Little Train

styles: soft brushed shaker like train wheels

lyrics:
[Listen]
Chug, chug, little train,
Choo choo, down the lane.
Chug, chug, round the bend,
Choo choo, wave a friend.

[Listen again]
Chug, chug, up the hill,
Choo choo, never still.
Chug, chug, down we go,
Choo choo, nice and slow.

[Together]
All aboard, you and me,
Choo choo, one, two, three!
All aboard, take a seat,
Choo choo, tap your feet.

[One more verse]
Chug, chug, through the rain,
Choo choo, little train.
Chug, chug, past the trees,
Choo choo, feel the breeze.

[All together]
Chug, chug, here's the station,
Choo choo, celebration!
Chug, chug, toot, toot, hey,
Choo choo, what a day!

title: Garden Friends

sections.name: Listen
lines: Little bee goes buzz, buzz, buzz,
Little bee goes buzz, buzz, buzz,

sections.name: Together
lines: Garden friends, we sing with you,
Garden friends, we sing with you,

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Little snail goes slow, slow, slow,
Little snail goes slow, slow, slow,

lyrics:
[Listen]
Little bee goes buzz, buzz, buzz,
Flying round the flowers.
Little bee goes buzz, buzz, buzz,
Busy, busy hours.

[Listen again]
Butterfly goes flap, flap, flap,
Colours in the sun.
Butterfly goes flap, flap, flap,
Having so much fun.

[Together]
Garden friends, we sing with you,
Buzz and flap and hop.
Garden friends, we sing with you,
Never want to stop.

[One more verse]
Little snail goes slow, slow, slow,
Carries home along.
Little snail goes slow, slow, slow,
Humming a slow song.

[All together]
Garden friends, goodbye for now,
Buzz and flap and hop.
Garden friends, take a bow,
And now we stop.

title: Swing High

styles: three beats in a bar, swaying

lyrics:
[Listen]
Swing up high,
Touch the sky.
Swing down low,
Here we go.

[Listen again]
Swing so far,
See a star.
Swing back near,
Mummy's here.

[Together]
Swing with me,
One, two, three.
Swing and sway,
Fly away.

[One more verse]
Wind in my hair,
Up in the air.
Feet to the trees,
Feel the breeze.

[All together]
Swing slow now,
Take a bow.
Swing to a stop,
Down we drop.

title: Peacock Dance

sections.name: Listen
lines: Blue and green from head to tail,

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Clouds are coming, rain is near,
Peacock calls for all to hear,

sections.name: Together
lines: Spin around and lift your hands,

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Step to the left and step to the right,

lyrics:
[Listen]
Peacock, peacock, spread your tail,
Dance, dance, dance.
Blue and green from head to tail,
Dance, dance, dance.

[Listen again]
Clouds are coming, rain is near,
Dance, dance, dance.
Peacock calls for all to hear,
Dance, dance, dance.

[Together]
Spin around and lift your hands,
Dance, dance, dance.
Peacock leads the garden band,
Dance, dance, dance.

[One more verse]
Step to the left and step to the right,
Dance, dance, dance.
Feathers shining, oh so bright,
Dance, dance, dance.

[All together]
Peacock, peacock, take a bow,
Dance, dance, dance.
Everybody, dance with us now,
Dance, dance, dance!

title: Goodnight, Little Feet
lyrics:
[Listen]
Goodnight, little feet,
Warm and sweet.
Goodnight, little hands,
Dreamy lands.

[Listen again]
Goodnight, little nose,
Eyes now close.
Goodnight, little ears,
Sleep is near.

[Together]
Goodnight, moon and stars,
Near and far.
Goodnight, everyone,
Day is done.

[One more verse]
Goodnight, teddy bear,
Sleeping there.
Goodnight, cosy bed,
Rest your head.

[All together]
Goodnight, little one,
Day is done.
Hush now, close your eyes,
Sweet lullabies.
